test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Jan 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Who was the Viceroy of India when Indian National Congress was founded?
solution:
The correct answer is **__Lord Dufferin.__**

**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Lord Dufferin** was the viceroy of **India **when the** Indian National Congress **was formed in **1885.**
 
• **Indian National Congress **was a major event of the tenure of **Viceroy Lord Dufferin.**
 
• The **tenure of Lord Dufferin **was from **1884 to1888.**
 
• The main aim of the **Indian National Congress **was to develop close relations between national workers, consolidation of national unity among all and dissolution of all religions, and nepotism.
 
• During** Lord Dufferin's tenure**, the following things took place-
 
 
• **Bengal Tenancy Act 1885.**
 
• **Third Burmese War and annexation of Burma (1885).**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Lord Curzon** served as Viceroy of India from 1899 to 1905.

 
 
• On the resignation of Lord Curzon, Lord Minto was appointed Viceroy and Governor-General of India from 1905 to 1910.
 
 
 
• **Lord Ripon** (1880-1884) was the Viceroy of India when the Ilbert bill was introduced in legislation.
 
 
• Lord Ripon was the son of Prime Minister F.J.Robinson(UK).
 
 
 
• **Lord Irwin** was the Viceroy of India from 1926-to 1931.
 
 
• Major Incidents took place in India under him:
 
 
• In 1928, Simon's commission came to India.
 
• The incidence of Dandi took in 1930.
 
• The Civil Disobedience movement was started in 1930.
